process.title: Our Process
process.step1Desc: Verified job demand received, attested and approved by the Department of Foreign Employment.
process.step2Desc: Jobs advertised, candidates sourced, CVs screened and shortlisted against employer requirements.
process.step3Desc: Employer interviews (online or in-person) and final selection of suitable candidates.
process.step4Desc: Medical examination, contract signing, work permit and visa processing handled for you.
process.step5Desc: Mandatory orientation on destination laws, culture, safety and workers' rights.
process.step6Desc: Ticketing, travel and post-placement follow-up for a smooth, safe experience.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for ethical foreign employment
about.whoText: Swostik Overseas Pvt. Ltd. is a government-licensed overseas recruitment agency based in Kathmandu, Nepal. We connect skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled Nepali workers with reputable employers across the Gulf, Asia and Europe through transparent and ethical practices.
about.missionText: To provide safe, fair and dignified foreign employment opportunities that transform the lives of Nepali workers and their families, while delivering reliable manpower to our global partners.
about.visionText: To be Nepal's most trusted and ethical overseas recruitment agency, recognized for integrity, transparency and worker welfare.
about.why1Desc: Fully licensed by the Department of Foreign Employment, Nepal.
about.why2Desc: Zero hidden costs and transparent processes at every step.
about.why3Desc: We only work with genuine, verified overseas employers.
about.why5Desc: Years of expertise in international manpower recruitment.
about.why6Desc: Your safety, rights and dignity come first, always.
